content:
General
* In its current form, the task may be too easy as a puzzle. I'd suggest either making it more challenging or using the idea for a clash of code instead.

* How [[Category]] is cleaned up currently has no impact on the output.

* The number of fields is always 5. It's fine to keep this as part of the output requirements, but I'd still like to point this out.

Goal
* Throughout the rules, please format 'Date', 'Category', 'Amount', 'Tax' and 'Net' as [[variables]] (e.g. [[date]]) and remove the quotation marks.

* Please change both instances of "becomes" to "is replaced with".

* Please format 'Unknown' as a {{constant}} and remove the quotation marks.

* It's a bit confusing to explain how an empty [[Amount]] is handled and define [[M]] in the same rule. I suggest splitting this into two separate rules:

- Calculate [[M]] as the mean of the non-empty [[Amount]] values of the kept transactions, rounded down.

- An empty [[Amount]] is replaced with [[M]].

* Please change "Each kept transaction, gets a [[Tax]] equal to" to "For each kept transaction, calculate [[Tax]] as".

* Please change
"a [[Net]] equal to"
to
"[[Net]] as".

* Please change "Amount - Tax" to "Amount minus Tax".

* Please move the final sentence into its own point, and add "cleaned-up" after "Each".

Input / Output / Constraints
* Please remove the headings, as they're displayed automatically. There's no need to repat them.

Input
* Please change 'Date,Category,Amount' to "A transaction containing three comma-separated values: [[Date]], [[Category]] and [[Amount]]".

Output
* Please add "space-separated" after "Two".

* Please change "The value of" to "An integer".

* Please change 'Date' to [[Date]] and remove the quotation marks.

* Please change ">" to "greater than".

Constraints
* Please change 1000 to 10 as [[N]] never exceeds 10. (It'd be even better to expand the test cases to include a wider range of [[N]] values, in which case the upper bound could be increased to 50 or 100, for example.)

* Please remove the third constraint, and add the following two constraints, each on a separate line:

A non-empty [[Date]] is in the format of [[YYYY]]{{-}}[[MM]]{{-}}[[DD]].
A non-empty [[Category]] consists of letters only.

* Please change "a 'Date' and an 'Amount'" to "a non-empty [[Date]] and a non-empty [[Amount]]".

Tags
* Please use existing tags rather than creating new ones. For example, you could replace "data science" with "Mathematics" and "Conditions".

Cases
* In the current test cases, all dates have the year 2026, and all transactions within each case occur in the same month. In case pairs 3 and 4, the dates also always fall between the 1st and 4th of the month. There should be greater variety in the dates, with a mix of years, months and days.

* Since the task may be revised, I'll review the test cases in more detail once it's closer to being finalised.

Thanks.
Thanks for the feedback everyone, i've changed the contribution to WIP as i address your points!

In general, I think specifying the method in the problem statement takes away the fun of figuring out the approach on your own. If you really want to mention Pandas, I suggest clearly separating the goal (what the output should be) from the method, and then noting that using Pandas is one possible approach as a hint.

I don't think it's a good idea to kind of make people solve this with Pandas. Some people might not know how to use it, really. 

Also please refer to 5DN1L's comments below.

❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: It's not possible to require players to solve the puzzle using Python and Pandas. They're free to use any other libraries or programming languages available on CodinGame.

I haven't reviewed the puzzle in detail yet. Below are some initial comments:

General
* Please change the contribution's status to WIP to allow reviewers more time to review it.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the variable names, constants and line numbers properly by following the example there.

Constraints
* Please ensure that the test cases cover the range of values permitted by the constraints in a balanced manner.

  For example, since N never exceeds 10 in the current test cases, the upper bound for N should be 10 rather than 1000. Alternatively, please add test cases with a wider variety of N values to cover the full range.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Tags
* Please remove all existing tags. A puzzle can be solved using any programming language supported by the platform, and it does not necessarily require the Pandas library.

  Also, "Beg" isn't a well-formed tag and is redundant in any case, as the puzzle's difficulty level is already set to Easy.

Cases
* Each test case is currently identical to its corresponding validator. Please revise them so that each test-validator pair covers the same scenario but uses slightly different inputs and expects different outputs.

Thanks.
